headline: Cox’s Bazar-Chattogram Highway to be upgraded to a six-lane motorway
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced the expansion plan during a public rally in Chakaria, citing it as a key route for regional economic development.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has announced that the Cox’s Bazar-Chattogram Highway will be upgraded to a six-lane motorway. He described the project as a critical route for the economic development of the region.
Speaking at a public rally in Chakaria on Saturday night, the Prime Minister stated that work to expand the current four-lane highway to six lanes would begin soon.
The Prime Minister noted that the road condition had not changed significantly in 25 years. He emphasized that a six-lane highway is essential for the area's growth.
During the visit, Tarique Rahman also inaugurated the re-excavation of the Patili Canal and launched a nationwide tree plantation programme of 2.5 billion trees from the Malumghat reserved forest.
He also visited the grave of July Uprising protester Md Wasim Akram in Pekua Upazila and laid foundation stones for the newly formed Pekua municipality and Matamuhuri Upazila.
This marks the Prime Minister's first visit to Cox’s Bazar since assuming office following the BNP's victory in the February 12 election.
caption:
The Cox’s Bazar-Chattogram Highway is getting a major upgrade. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has announced it will become a six-lane motorway.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has announced that the Cox’s Bazar-Chattogram Highway will be upgraded to a six-lane motorway. He described the project as a critical route for the economic development of the region.

Speaking at a public rally in Chakaria on Saturday night, the Prime Minister stated that work to expand the current four-lane highway to six lanes would begin soon.

The Prime Minister noted that the road condition had not changed significantly in 25 years. He emphasized that a six-lane highway is essential for the area's growth.

During the visit, Tarique Rahman also inaugurated the re-excavation of the Patili Canal and launched a nationwide tree plantation programme of 2.5 billion trees from the Malumghat reserved forest.

He also visited the grave of July Uprising protester Md Wasim Akram in Pekua Upazila and laid foundation stones for the newly formed Pekua municipality and Matamuhuri Upazila.

This marks the Prime Minister's first visit to Cox’s Bazar since assuming office following the BNP's victory in the February 12 election.

headline: Tragedy in Bhola: Brazil supporter killed in motorcycle accident
summary: A fan was traveling to join a celebratory procession in Borhanuddin, Bhola, when the fatal crash occurred.
details: A Brazil football supporter was killed in a motorcycle accident in Borhanuddin, Bhola.
The victim was on his way to participate in a celebratory procession organized by Brazil supporters in the area.
The accident occurred as the fan was traveling to join the festivities, turning a day of celebration into tragedy.
